numeric_contract.coefficient_model: Existing GGUF to_float per complete row, then fixed signed W8 [-127,127]. This is the declared full-FFN W8 numeric model; it is not a claim of equivalence to original GGUF Q4 arithmetic.
numeric_contract.row_scale: F32 maxabs(row)/127; zero row uses1. std::round then clamp [-127,127]. Original per-row scales remain associated with complete logical rows.
numeric_contract.activation: Once per entire operator input vector: F32 maxabs/127 (zero vector scale1), round and clamp to A8 [-127,127]. No row/chip partial scales; Down waits for the whole nonlinear hidden vector.
numeric_contract.dot_and_output: CPU exact I64 sum of I8 products; F32 sw*sx, cast integer sum to F32, then F32 multiply. Compile flags disable fast-math and FP contraction.
numeric_contract.routing: Actual ffn_moe_topk callback IDs; all40 full-FFN layers execute, attention/router retain GGUF. Fixed16 decode steps; no synthetic topk sampler.
numeric_contract.capture_scope: Canonical-only full-FFN route collection. New routed rows/logits are NOT rerun in a placed mode. Prior paired G4 andDeepSeek proofs are referenced, not extended by this capture. Shared/dense still execute the unchanged packed-vs-canonical I64 check in the old operator.
numeric_contract.critical_limit: Collector unsharded mode computes routed canonical rows and does not execute these three M32 maps. Its legacy16-chip packed shared helper is not a new M32 paired proof.
